title: Korean-Style Tempeh Tagine
description: A fusion twist on traditional French cuisine, combining the bold flavors of Korea with the rich flavors of a French tagine. This dish is a unique and exciting way to experience the flavors of both cuisines.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the tempeh and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, ginger, chili flakes, and diced tomatoes.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
